28:58.text: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its
living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly.
And it is We who were the inheritors.

28:59.text: And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother
a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.
